frameworks: Auth.js v5 with JWT sessions revoked by per-user session_epoch
Model Context Protocol server over Streamable HTTP (apps/mcp)
Kysely + pg (packages/core, the only database path)
clouds: single VPS behind a CDN/WAF reverse proxy that terminates TLS
datastores: PostgreSQL 18 with row-level security (ENABLE + FORCE) on content tables
Cloudflare R2 buckets for attachments (quarantine and served prefixes)
pgBackRest WAL archive / PITR and daily pg_dump backups
identity_providers: email one-time code via AUTH_EMAIL_CODE (self-host, optional; off on noergo.com)
external_integrations: Stripe Checkout, customer portal and webhooks
MCP clients registered through Dynamic Client Registration (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Cursor)
personal API tokens (nrg_) for scripts and API clients
tenancy_model: one personal workspace per user; workspace_id is the tenant key
workspace_members roles owner/editor/viewer exist in the schema; sharing is not designed yet
deployment: one Docker image for web, mcp and worker, published to GHCR with SBOM and provenance attestation
non-root user, read-only root filesystem, cap_drop ALL
self-hosters run the same image with BILLING=off, STORAGE=s3|local, SIGNUP=open|allowlist

explicit_exclusions: noergo.com production: passive checks only; no dynamic, load, credential, brute-force or social-engineering tests
Third-party services (Google, Microsoft, Stripe, Cloudflare, GitHub, MCP client vendors) are not test targets; only noergo's integration with them, using sandbox or test modes
Self-hosted instances not operated by the maintainer
Profile C controls (DAT-007, LOG-006, SUP-008) are not selected; selecting DAT-007 is an open decision recorded in THREAT_MODEL.md
